title: Using the 3D Driver Cabin
summary: Interact with imported cabin meshes without altering the author-created GLB structure.
prerequisites: Imported model includes identifiable interactive controls

steps.title: Open the 3D cabin
steps.body: Navigate to Simulators → 3D and use Start to begin an active training session.

steps.title: Look around
steps.body: Drag to look around the cab in 360°. Use the configured movement keys to move within the interior boundaries.

steps.title: Operate the master handle
steps.body: Click or drag the imported lever. Positions are EB, B3, B2, B1, N, P1, P2, P3.

steps.title: Operate in-cab buttons
steps.body: Click the original emergency and passenger-door control meshes. Use an emergency-reset mesh only if one is present and mapped.

steps.title: Read instruments
steps.body: Inspect the speedometer, main display, brake indications, and door lamps. Display surfaces require correctly named and UV-mapped meshes.

notes: The 3D code should never reconstruct the artist cabin geometry.
For missing controls or gauges, validate the exported node names, UV maps, and visibility; do not create substitute geometry.
Start, Stop, Reset and Full Screen are session controls outside the 3D cab.
